module.purpose: Loads a booking event type and its related scheduling, host, user, calendar, workflow, and policy data from the database, then normalizes it into the response shape required by new-booking flows.
module.summary: This module performs one comprehensive Prisma event-type lookup with nested relations for teams, profiles, users, hosts, schedules, calendars, workflows, locations, availability, and booking policies. It enriches users with selected calendars, validates metadata and recurring-event fields through schemas, adds system booking fields, and returns a normalized event type marked as non-dynamic. Missing database records fail through the ORM's throwing lookup behavior.
module.businessContext: Supports booking creation by assembling all event configuration and scheduling participants needed to offer or process a booking. Failure prevents the booking flow from obtaining valid event-type rules, hosts, calendars, or customer-facing fields.
functions: getEventTypesFromDB (~L15-201): Loads and normalizes a database-backed event type for booking creation

io: Queries the database for one event type and its nested related records.

edgeCases.behavior: The throwing database lookup raises an error and no response is returned.
Nullish values are replaced with empty objects or arrays before schema parsing.
Nullish locations become an empty array before the LocationObject cast.
The value is schema-parsed and normalized to null when the parsed result is nullish.
Mapping produces empty enriched collections without changing the query result shape.

errorHandling.action: Propagates the database lookup failure to the caller.
Propagates parsing failures for metadata, recurring events, custom inputs, or round-robin segment values.

invariants.description: The returned object always sets isDynamic to false.
The database lookup must resolve an event type or throw before normalization.
Hosts and users in the result are transformed through selected-calendar enrichment.
Metadata, recurring-event data, custom inputs, and round-robin segment values are schema-normalized.

assumptions.description: Callers provide a numeric event type identifier and handle the rejected promise when lookup or validation fails.
The selected Prisma event-type shape remains compatible with the downstream schema parsers and booking-field builder.
Prisma, calendar enrichment, workflow selection, and imported schema utilities are initialized and usable when the function runs.
